entries.text: Discovered programming with C and C++.
Joined EPITECH and became a full-time programmer — valedictorian of the first semester.
Second year at EPITECH: the pace picks up, and I keep learning new things and sharpening my skills.
Six-month internship at Wildsense as a fullstack and mobile developer.
End of my second year at EPITECH — much stronger skills, a lot more experience and knowledge.
Part-time internship at Wildsense, in the same role as the first one.
Internship at OVHcloud as a backend and AI developer: research on LLMs, their deployment methods and their integration into OVHcloud services.
A year in Korea at Korea University, specialising in software architecture and AI.
